facts.fact: ICTworks lists Niger's operative instrument as the Schéma Directeur National de Santé Numérique, validated 28-30 May 2025 per Le Sahel, and says the instruments adopted by seven countries including Niger share an EHR component among others; the primary text was not locatable and no Niger system is named.
facts.system: EHR (component of the Schéma Directeur National de Santé Numérique, unnamed)

note: A continental directory of strategies; the one emr fact rests on a statement made about seven countries collectively, with no deployed system named for Niger. Nothing is stated about an HMIS.
